svg.title: Four Core Seats, Two Scale Seats
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-four-to-six-person-pod; chart type: org_architecture; title: Four Core Seats, Two Scale Seats; subtitle: Base and Conservative: 2 FT + 2 C; Scaled: 3 FT + 3 C.; chapter number: 11; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Each stage represents one person; contractor seats are part-time engagements, not full-time equivalents. Numeric values represent one person each. First four seats form the core pod; final two are scale additions. Compensation is scenario-specific and must be tested against actual hiring costs.; caption: Conservative: $120,000 revenue and $30,000 owner net at 25%. Base: $560,000 and $196,000 at 35%. Scaled: $1,000,000 and $450,000 at 45%; the scaled scenario uses six people.; stages: label: Principal and relationship lead; value: Core seat | 1 FT; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own borrower qualification, lender relationships, engagement terms, concentration reviews, and fee disputes. The owner occupies this operating seat rather than appearing as an uncounted fifth core team member.; label: Credit operations lead; value: Core seat | 1 FT; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own application checklists, lender-matrix freshness, submission quality, closing conditions, and CRM accuracy. Use Airtable and HubSpot automation to surface missing documents without automating lender credit decisions.; label: File analysis specialist; value: Core seat | 1 C; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Reconcile financial statements, receivables aging, equipment schedules, and borrower debt. Work from restricted assignments and escalate unexplained balance differences before the operations lead releases submissions.; label: Transaction controls specialist; value: Core seat | 1 C; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Maintain fee evidence, renewal tracking, access reviews, and exception records. Coordinate outside counsel on licensing or securities questions without representing this contractor as a substitute for required expertise.; label: Additional relationship manager; value: Scale addition | 1 FT; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Expand qualified borrower coverage and lender depth when sustained pipeline demand supports a third full-time seat. Measure funded retained fees and closing quality rather than raw submission volume.; label: Closing and renewal coordinator; value: Scale addition | 1 C; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Absorb closing-condition follow-up, settlement matching, and renewal scheduling at scaled throughput. Add capacity only after the core pod demonstrates reliable fee collection and bounded exception backlogs.
